description: ORCINUS: a verification-first engineering skill collection — one integrated nervous system for the 0–100 software lifecycle, from raw idea to release. Router + 35 focused sub-skills, shared glossary, evidence bundles, independent review. No auto-merge, no weakened tests. Evidence bundles make an incomplete or self-contradictory verification impossible to file as PASS; they do not prove the commands ran.
name: orcinus-skills
